info.title: SUAS API
info.description: Machine-readable contract for the implemented `/api/v0` surface. Authentication is an opaque Bearer credential; this API never reads cookies. Browser callers on origins listed in `SUAS_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` receive CORS headers and preflight answers (D-038, released in spec 0.7.0); other browser-originated unsafe requests receive `403 FORBIDDEN`. Paths document what the runtime registers today; draft APIS.md Plane A paths that are not yet implemented are intentionally absent.

post.description: Runs the Intake Assistant (two tools: search_resources, draft_service_request). A new Service Request Draft is stored only when the assistant answers (201). When it does not, nothing is stored and the response is 200 with outcome FALLBACK_FORM. The text is never logged. Requires a Veteran who passed the ID scan and selfie check (403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED otherwise).

200.description: Assistant unavailable or failed: show the plain request form

outcome.description: FALLBACK_FORM: the assistant did not answer and nothing was stored; show the plain request form (`request_form`).

post.description: Appends the text to the draft and runs the assistant again with the current draft. If the assistant fails the draft is unchanged and outcome is FALLBACK_FORM. Requires a Veteran who passed the ID scan and selfie check (403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED otherwise).

outcome.description: FALLBACK_FORM: the assistant did not answer and nothing was stored; show the plain request form (`request_form`).

post.summary: Submit a draft as a Service Request
post.description: The only way a draft becomes a Service Request. Opens the Support Case if needed, creates the request and submits it. Requires a Veteran who passed the ID scan and selfie check (403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED otherwise). Requires a county (422 COUNTY_REQUIRED).
